about: Nora, built from MakeHuman's CC0 assets by makehuman_nora.py, after her profile picture (public/nora-avatar.png; owner, 2026-10-26: "can you make nora look like her profile/avatar picture", "her face needs to be slimmed down", "dont have nora dressed in a suit when shes djing"): a slim woman around 30, light skin with a few freckles, brown eyes, full dark brows, a soft smile, long dark-brown hair worn down; for the decks, a black camisole top and dark trousers; about 1.70 m. face_photo: a front-on, evenly lit photo of her (Higgsfield, job 2e1b8ae6-677b-48a6-a4b9-eaf0e3858499, nano_banana_pro reported nano_banana_2) baked onto the face by photo_face.py; it brings her brows, so there are no brow cards. face: MakeHuman modelling targets and their weights. tints: colours multiplied into a texture (sRGB, 0-1). Optional: hair_alpha / hair_underlayer (how solid the hair cards are drawn; fine-strand hair wants little boost and no opaque under-layer) and credits (what a CC BY asset asks to be credited for; written into the VRM meta). A long wavy fine-strand hair (punkduck_alpha7_curly2, CC BY) was tried and dropped: once she moved, it fell across her face.
